Kuota Lesen

2. Bagi maksud seksyen 9 Akta, kuota lesen bagi setiap jenis burung liar yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual bagi Negeri yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) adalah

seperti yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3).

WILDLIFE CONSERVATION ACT 2010

WILDLIFE CONSERVATION (QUOTA OF LICENCE) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 35(e) of the Wildlife Conservation

Act 2010 [Act 716], the Director General, with the approval of the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Wildlife Conservation (Quota of Licence)

Order 2013.

Quota of Licence

2. For the purpose of section 9 of the Act, the quota of licence for each type of wild

birds stated in column (1) of the Schedule for the States stated in column (2) is as stated

in column (3).

SCHEDULE

(1) (2) (3)

Type of Wild Bird States Quota of Licence

Type of protected wild bird―

(a) Common Shama – Copsychus

malabricus

(b) Oriental White-eye – Zosterops

palpebrose

Johore 150

Kelantan 150

Pahang 150

Perak 150

Terengganu 150

Kedah 75

Negeri Sembilan 75

Selangor 75

Malacca 30

Perlis 30

Penang 30

Revocation

3. The Wildlife Conservation (Quota of Licence) Order 1988 [P.U. (A) 298/1988]

dated 23 August 1988 is revoked.

Made 10 December 2013

[NRE(S) 44/4/1/47; PN(PU2)697/IV]

DATO' ABD RASID BIN SAMSUDIN

Director General

Peninsular Malaysia
